summary.text: Lori Palmeri is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 54 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her current term as beginning on January 3, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Lori Palmeri was born in Takoma Park, Maryland, and lives in Wisconsin, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a B.A. in urban and regional studies from the University of Wisconsin, Oshkosh, and a master's in urban planning from the University of Wisconsin, Milwaukee.
Her career experience includes working as a substitute teacher in the Oshkosh School District, a medical courier for CS Logistics and a finance recruiting administrator for Kimberly Clark.

Palmeri was elected to the Oshkosh Common Council and as mayor of Oshkosh, and served on the East Central Wisconsin Regional Planning Commission, the Oshkosh Redevelopment Authority and the Oshkosh Planning Commission.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was elected to the Common Council in 2016, became the first woman directly elected mayor of Oshkosh in 2019 and was reelected in 2021.
Palmeri was assigned to the Environment Committee, the Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation Committee and the Local Government Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
